content.english: I call to God Most High, girded with might,
Who, in His wisdom, established the miracles of creation
And, with His commandments, chose the pure congregation
To observe the holy Sabbath day in splendor.
Arise to the betrothal, O pure bride,
Shine akin to a candle, O precious soul!
The One who reads hidden thoughts summoned relief

content.hebrew: הִזְהִיר לְבַל נַעְשֶֹה : בּוֹ שׁוּם מְלָאכָה
content.transliteration: Hiz-hir leval na‘sé : bo shum melacha
content.english: And cautioned us not to work on that day,
When I sacrifice two sheep, along with a meal-offering,
To sing joyfully to greet the bride with praises and songs!
Arise to the betrothal, O pure bride,
Shine akin to a candle, O precious soul!
The first of the sacred occasions is esteemed.
It is forbidden to pursue any affairs of work!

content.hebrew: כִּי כָל מְחַלֵּל הוּא : נִסְפֶּה וְיֹאבַד
content.transliteration: Ki chol meḥallel hu : nispé veyovad
content.english: For those who desecrate the Sabbath will perish and be gone,
But upon its keepers, He will bestow everlasting glory.
Arise to the betrothal, O pure bride,
Shine akin to a candle, O precious soul!
The splendor of the holy abode; the delight of holiness!
We shall serve our Creator during those six days—
This seventh day is our inheritance!
Study this deep secret, which was stated on the mountain!
Arise to the betrothal, O pure bride,
Shine akin to a candle, O precious soul!
[God] will give a double reward to the admonisher and to the admonished,
Crowned with eternity, his soul [will be] with his Rock.
His horn will be exalted, yet abiding in His splendor.
He will keep [him] and give a sign: Salvation and light!
Arise to the betrothal, O pure bride,
Shine akin to a candle, O precious soul!

content.hebrew: חֹ֒ק זֶ֒ה קְ֒דוֹשׁ יַעֲקֹב : הִנְחִיל בְּחַסְדּוֹ
content.transliteration: Ḥoḳ zé ḳedosh ya‘aḳov : hinḥil beḥasdo
content.english: The Holy one of Jacob bequeathed this law in His mercy:
Hallow the eternal covenant, His beloved offspring!
He will soon take care of Zion and reveal His glory.
He will supply our souls with perfect redemption.
Arise to the betrothal, O pure bride,
Shine akin to a candle, O precious soul!

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב: וּפְדוּיֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה יְשׁוּב֗וּן וּבָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּרִנָּ֔ה וְשִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֑ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְשִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂיג֔וּן נָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַאֲנָחָֽה׃(ישעיהו נא,יא)
content.transliteration: Kakkatuv: Ufduyé adonai yeshuvun uva’u tsiyyon berinna vesimḥat ‘olam ‘al rosham sason vesimḥa yassiḡun nasu yaḡon va’anaḥa.
content.english: As it is written: So let the ransomed of Adonai return, and come with shouting to Zion, crowned with joy everlasting. Let them attain joy and gladness, while sorrow and sighing flee. (Is. 51:11).
